Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: eight separate decoration cutouts for Confined volcanic tunnel
Style: Weathered dark fantasy pixel art. Broad readable shapes, deliberate stepped color clusters, restrained outlines and a small muted palette. Material identity comes from silhouette and a few grouped marks. Refined material edges and deliberate fine pixel clusters at the Wetlands texture density. Keep local contrast restrained behind actors; distant layers use a narrower value range. Preserve full texture resolution independently of the logical layout. Do not enlarge a coarse pixel grid to create quiet scenery.
Palette: Charcoal basalt, muted brown-black, ash gray and sparse dark burnt-orange seams.
Lighting: Dim reflected amber from sparse narrow seams below, with cool charcoal shadow and no glowing haze.
Prop detail: Medium detail concentrated at the outer silhouette and a few identifying features. Keep interior shading grouped. Show one complete isolated object with a clear support contact.
Exactly FOUR columns by TWO rows, eight equal cells, wide 2:1 canvas 2048 by 1024. Each cell contains exactly one complete isolated prop or the specified small grouped object, centered with at least 40 pixels of clear padding on every side. No grid lines or labels. All props sit on a flat invisible ground line within their own cell, with no cast shadow, ground patch or backdrop. Strict orthographic side view, no strong overhead perspective. Real transparent alpha outside every object, including holes and between cells.
Cell order, left to right then top to bottom:
1. Layered basalt boulder
2. Small squat obsidian outcrop with restrained dull red reflections
3. Cracked ash-filled stone urn
4. Low cooled lava vent with one faint ember seam and no smoke
5. Heavy iron brazier with a few dull embers
6. Abandoned iron ore cart carrying volcanic stone
7. Rusted chain coiled beside a broken mining pick
8. Broken natural basalt column with a flat grounded base
Keep each object entirely within its cell, especially poles and handles. No characters, words, symbols, checkerboard, walls, floors or roof.
